author: Will
short: Simple administration logs for members, messages, voice, and server changes.
description: Configurable per-server log channel for joins/leaves, nicknames, roles, profiles, bans, timeouts, message deletions/edits, voice activity, and channel/role/server changes. Deleted text is available only when cached by Red. Long records are preserved as text attachments. Automatically pauses message logging in an active AcroGame channel and suppresses delayed deletions of game messages. Per-server ignorebot/unignorebot settings exclude selected bots from message deletion/edit records.
install_msg: Run [p]load adminlog, then [p]adminlog channel #admin-logs. Enable Server Members and Message Content intents. Use [p]adminlog status and [p]adminlog test to check setup.
end_user_data_statement: Persists each server's log channel ID and ignored bot user IDs in Red Config. Sends user IDs, names, nicknames, roles, activity, and available edited/deleted message content and attachment URLs into the configured Discord channel. These Discord records remain until administrators delete them; Red data-deletion requests do not purge them. Holds at most 10,000 ignored/self-bot message IDs with guild and bot author IDs in memory, containing no message text, cleared on cog reload/restart. Red data-deletion requests remove matching ignored bot settings and registry entries. Uses Red's existing temporary message cache for available message text; maintains no additional content archive.
